verses.text: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:

segments.text: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:

verses.text: To know wisdom and instruction; To discern the words of understanding;

segments.text: To know wisdom and instruction;
To discern the words of understanding;

verses.text: To receive instruction in wise dealing, In righteousness and justice and equity;

segments.text: To receive instruction in wise dealing,

verses.text: To give prudence to the simple, To the young man knowledge and discretion:

segments.text: To give prudence to the simple,
To the young man knowledge and discretion:

verses.text: That the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; And that the man of understanding may attain unto sound counsels:

segments.text: That the wise man may hear, and increase in learning;
And that the man of understanding may attain unto sound counsels:

verses.text: To understand a proverb, and a figure, The words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

segments.text: To understand a proverb, and a figure,
The words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

verses.text: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of knowledge; But the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

segments.text: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of knowledge;
But
the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

verses.text: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:

segments.text: My son, hear the instruction of thy father,
And forsake not the law of thy mother:

verses.text: For they shall be a chaplet of grace unto thy head, And chains about thy neck.

segments.text: For they shall be a chaplet of grace unto thy head,
And chains about thy neck.

verses.text: My son, if sinners entice thee, Consent thou not.

segments.text: My son, if sinners entice thee,
Consent thou not.

verses.text: If they say, Come with us, Let us lay wait for blood; Let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause;

segments.text: If they say, Come with us,
Let us lay wait for blood;
Let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause;

verses.text: Let us swallow them up alive as Sheol, And whole, as those that go down into the pit;

segments.text: Let us swallow them up alive as Sheol,
And whole, as those that go down into the pit;

verses.text: We shall find all precious substance; We shall fill our houses with spoil;

segments.text: We shall find all precious substance;
We shall fill our houses with spoil;

verses.text: Thou shalt cast thy lot among us; We will all have one purse:

segments.text: Thou shalt cast thy lot among us;
We will all have one purse:

verses.text: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; Refrain thy foot from their path:

segments.text: My son, walk not thou in the way with them;
Refrain thy foot from their path:

verses.text: For their feet run to evil, And they make haste to shed blood.

segments.text: For their feet run to evil,
And they make haste to shed blood.

verses.text: For in vain is the net spread In the sight of any bird:

segments.text: For in vain is the net spread
In the sight of any bird:

verses.text: And these lay wait for their own blood; They lurk privily for their own lives.

segments.text: And these lay wait for their own blood;
They lurk privily for their own lives.

verses.text: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; It taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

segments.text: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain;

verses.text: Wisdom crieth aloud in the street; She uttereth her voice in the broad places;

segments.text: Wisdom crieth aloud in the street;
She uttereth her voice in the broad places;

verses.text: She crieth in the chief place of concourse; At the entrance of the gates, In the city, she uttereth her words:

segments.text: She crieth in the chief place of concourse;
At the entrance of the gates,
In the city, she uttereth her words:

verses.text: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? And scoffers delight them in scoffing, And fools hate knowledge?

segments.text: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity?
And scoffers delight them in scoffing,
And fools hate knowledge?

verses.text: Turn you at my reproof: Behold, I will pour out my spirit upon you; I will make known my words unto you.

segments.text: Turn you at my reproof:
Behold, I will pour out my spirit upon you;

verses.text: Because I have called, and ye have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man hath regarded;

segments.text: Because I have called, and ye have refused;
I have stretched out my hand, and no man hath regarded;

verses.text: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, And would none of my reproof:

segments.text: But ye have set at nought all my counsel,
And would none of my reproof:

verses.text: I also will laugh in the day of your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

verses.text: When your fear cometh as a storm, And your calamity cometh on as a whirlwind; When distress and anguish come upon you.

verses.text: Then will they call upon me, but I will not answer; They will seek me diligently, but they shall not find me:

segments.text: Then will they call upon me, but I will not answer;

verses.text: For that they hated knowledge, And did not choose the fear of Jehovah,

segments.text: For that they hated knowledge,

verses.text: They would none of my counsel, They despised all my reproof.

segments.text: They would none of my counsel,

verses.text: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, And be filled with their own devices.

segments.text: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way,

verses.text: For the backsliding of the simple shall slay them, And the careless ease of fools shall destroy them.

segments.text: For the backsliding of the simple shall slay them,

verses.text: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell securely, And shall be quiet without fear of evil.
